# First Officer by UpNonStop

> First Officer is a rewards desk for business card spend: one conversation with First Officer across every loyalty program on the owner's file, working for the business owner. One flat plan at $550 a month. Award bookings are a separate $500 per itinerary. The Found Money Call is free and takes 20 minutes. US businesses only.

Plain facts, as stated on the site:

- Every connection is read-only. Nothing moves without the owner's yes; every transfer or booking waits for approval.
- Every Friday the owner gets a report with the dollar value of what was captured that week, est.
- No affiliate money from any bank, airline or hotel program, ever.
- No guaranteed savings. Every figure shown is an estimate, labelled est. Award space is set by each program and is not guaranteed.
- Not financial, tax or legal advice. The desk does not replace an accountant or financial advisor.
- UpNonStop, 235 Pavonia Avenue, Jersey City, NJ 07302. WhatsApp +1 619 940 4040.

- [Calculator · What is your spend worth?](https://firstofficer.upnonstop.com/calculator.html): One slider for your monthly business card spend, and what the desk could find against $550 a month, est. Go advanced to set your trade and spend line by line.
- [Trust | What we see, what we never touch](https://firstofficer.upnonstop.com/trust.html): Read-only connections, your approval first, no affiliate money and what we do not claim.
- [About · Why a desk, not another hack](https://firstofficer.upnonstop.com/about.html): Why First Officer exists, the rules we work by and the four pillars: Earn, Burn, Return, Learn.
- [Book the Found Money Call](https://firstofficer.upnonstop.com/book.html): Twenty minutes, free. See what your business card spend missed, against $550 a month.
- [Freebies · 433 items for business owners](https://firstofficer.upnonstop.com/freebies.html): Everything I'd tell you over coffee: 433 smart items for business owners, free to read. Leave your email for the new ones.
- [Industries · 20 trades, one desk](https://firstofficer.upnonstop.com/industries.html): Your trade, your codes: 20 industries, each with an example monthly mix, the codes your vendors usually run under, and a calculator preset.
- [Field Notes | How the rewards game works](https://firstofficer.upnonstop.com/field-notes.html): Eight short notes on what a point is worth, cash back, timing, expiry and who card advice serves. Illustrative estimates.
- [The Intelligence Report](https://firstofficer.upnonstop.com/upns.html): The Intelligence Report, every Saturday: transfer bonuses worth acting on, quiet repricings and one save from a wallet like yours. Three issues to read in full.
- [The App](https://firstofficer.upnonstop.com/the-app.html): The First Officer app, coming soon: the four pillars at a glance, your thread with the desk and the Friday count in dollars. Today the desk lives in WhatsApp.
